Nutrition label images for the reader's tests and the ?labellab harness.

fda-label-1.png
  The FDA's sample Nutrition Facts label ("Label 1"), a US government work in
  the public domain. Downloaded 2026-09-12 from
    https://www.fda.gov/media/132222/download
  listed on
    https://www.fda.gov/food/nutrition-food-labeling-and-critical-foods/nutrition-facts-label-images-download
  The PDF is vector; the label panel was rendered at 250 dpi (PyMuPDF, clip
  rect 303,137 → 491,468 pt) to a 653×1150 RGB PNG. The FDA notes these samples
  are "for educational purposes only" and do not meet 21 CFR 101.9 as printed.

fda-label-1.tokens.json
  The reader's exact output for fda-label-1.png at engine
  pp-ocrv6-tiny@9ef676d6ed3c with onnxruntime-web 1.29.0 — the golden file
  tests/labelScan.ocr.test.ts holds every change against. Regenerate only on
  purpose:  npx vite-node scripts/ocr-smoke.ts tests/fixtures/labels/fda-label-1.png --json

fda-dual-column.png
  "Dual Column Display, Per Serving and Per Container", page 7 of the FDA's
  "The New Nutrition Facts Label: Examples of Different Formats"
    https://www.fda.gov/media/99203/download
  rendered at 250 dpi (clip rect 190,215 → 440,545 pt), 869×1147.

fda-label-1-photo-sim.jpg
  Derived from fda-label-1.png to stand in for a phone photo: paper tint on a
  grey-brown card, rotated 3°, Gaussian blur σ=1.0 px, 60,000 pixels of ±18
  noise (seed 7), 1200×1600, JPEG quality 88. Not a real photograph; real
  photos from both phones are still the missing evaluation set.

fda-dual-column.tokens.json
fda-label-1-photo-sim.tokens.json
  The reader's exact output for the two images above, same engine and runtime
  as fda-label-1.tokens.json. Held by tests/labelScan.parse.real.test.ts and
  tests/labelScan.e2e.test.ts. Regenerate the same way, only on purpose.
